title: Why Kim Jong Un Should Want a 4th Summit With Donald Trump
gist: Kim Jong Un has so far rejected Donald Trump's push for a fourth summit, but the author argues, drawing on decades of North Korea analysis, that some in Pyongyang may see large benefits from one, though not the benefits Washington expects. The excerpt frames the case the North Korean Foreign Ministry would make to Kim, based on the three first-term summits and Pyongyang's reading of Trump's current foreign policy.
